local.note: Local only: Whisper plus the fail-closed DeBERTa masker, measured on this device. Deliberately kept apart from the network figure below, because a slow answer caused by wifi is not caused by the privacy system.

llm.note: Not run: no API key was configured, so no request left this machine. The payload each request would have carried was still built by the real client and is in e2e_outbound_payloads.jsonl.

end_to_end.success_definition: usable transcript, masking released, no raw private value in the outbound payload, deterministic rehydration probe restored every value. The four transport-dependent conditions are not counted in this run because no key was configured.

privacy_round_trip.definition: Checks against the bytes the LLM client handed to urllib, not against the arguments a function was called with. Every side is number-folded first, so a telephone number spoken as words and written by the recognizer as digits still matches. The two headline counts answer different questions and must not be added together: `masked_but_leaked` is a value the masker replaced that left the device anyway, which is a boundary failure and must be zero; `missed_by_detector_and_in_payload` is a gold entity the privacy model never found, which is a recall miss and is why the audio benchmark exists. A pipeline can have a perfect boundary and an imperfect detector, and this run says which.

placeholder_preservation.definition: Of the replies that used any bracketed token at all, how many used only tokens that were in the request. A reply containing [Name], [GIVENNAME] or an invented [TIME_1] counts as corrupted, because no local map can fill it. Meaningful only against a live model: a stubbed run scores the responder this file wrote.

rate_limiting.definition: A case is rate limited when both the primary and the fallback model refused it with HTTP 429. Retry-After is honoured once, capped at 60s; past that the case is recorded as rate limited and the run continues rather than waiting out a quota window.

local_command.note: no PII, device command - must not call Groq
local_command.transcript: Turn the kitchen lights off, please.
local_command.masked_text: Turn the kitchen lights off, please.
